Kind of like EBOX but with Podracing...thus EBOP.

== Strategy ==

Well, if you have run EBOX, you know how to run this.  Set up EBO quick using Garrison to grab any characters you can.  Place Incom Corporation as far into the Echo sites as possible in the event that your opponent does decide to enter Hoth.

On top of that, you have Podracing.  Use your A Step Backwards to remove their destiny if they run a racer.  Use We Wish To Board At Once to grab them as often as you possibly can.  With 3 of each in your deck, you should be in good shape.  Destiny is reasonably high with about half the destinies in the deck being 4 or greater, and being cards that never hit the table and stay.

Figrin D'an is in there as an homage to one of the great EBOX players in the area.  I ran a deck close to this at his last tournament and he suggested I put in Figrin.  He may be a low destiny, but getting yet one more way to retreive, it really isn't that bad an idea.

Winning the podrace is key to this deck.  I Did It! gets you some more retreival, Malastare gets you force drain +1 at the system.

Enter the Beuracrat does hurt this deck.  However, if you are worried about Enter the Beuracrat, just drain for 2.  Don't worry about setting up EBO - just drain at the system, let the sites float.

Overall, it is a fun deck.  I love playing it against You May Start Your Landing.
